links.outcome: LLM item-level rating concordance against clinician reference standard ratings
links.effect: Across 3931 item-level ratings, all models showed good agreement with clinicians (ICC 0.816-0.872), GPT-4o highest; Claude 3.5 and Gemini 2.5 yielded higher patient-level symptom burden.
links.quote: Across 3931 item-level ratings, all models showed good agreement with clinicians (intraclass correlation coefficient: 0.816-0.872), with GPT-4o showing the highest agreement.

unlisted_practices: Clinician adjudication of LLM mismatches using an error etiology taxonomy
Meta-evaluation of LLM rationales (citation, structure, mapping, expansion) and association with absolute error

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of LLMs' ability to reproduce clinician distress ratings and rationales from interview transcripts; it benchmarks models and analyzes error characteristics rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
